title: Quantized Low-Rank Quantum State Tomography: Hyperbolic Quantization and Riemannian Least-Squares Recovery
summary: We study low-rank quantum state tomography from finite-bit Pauli batch responses. To avoid bias introduced by generic quantization, we propose HyperQuant, a mean-preserving hyperbolic quantizer adapted to the second-moment scale of Pauli responses. We establish minimax distortion guarantees and show that exact mean preservation enables direct rank-constrained least-squares recovery without altering the population target.
